newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE COCOA ENDS MIXED, VOLUME THIN.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE COCOA ENDS MIXED, VOLUME THIN.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa ended tightly mixed, with the nearby months firmer in quiet trade.
Front month September last traded one stg higher at 1,022 stg, on volume of 739 lots, having ranged between 1,017 and 1,028.
Active December, with 916 of the total 2,467 lots, last traded two stg higher at 1,053 stg. Its day's range was 1,048 to 1,060 stg.
"It's been one of the quietest days for a long time," one trader said.
Cocoa had opened higher as expected, but came back from highs during the morning as the third month March failed to make a convincing break of resistance, traders said.
However, it was underpinned by concerns over the effect on the crop of the El Nino weather system, the trader said.
Afternoon trade was extremely quiet. "A lot of the industry closes in August," the trader said. And many traders had taken the chance to go away.
